result.summary: Found 3 issues: content cut off at the right edge of horizontal scroll sections, a truncated restaurant name, and inconsistent spacing/alignment in the bottom card section.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section cuts off the third card (Trattoria Piccolo) abruptly at the screen edge, making it unclear that more content is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek indicator or fade gradient at the edge to signal scrollability, or ensure cards are fully visible with proper padding.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without an ellipsis or clear indication, making it look like a text rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Add proper text truncation with ellipsis (...) or reduce font size to fit the name within the card.

issues.description: The pizza image card at the bottom is cut off by the navigation bar with no visible restaurant name or details, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent card layout with visible text content before the viewport cutoff, or add scroll padding so the last visible card is fully rendered.
